subject.title: [Feature]: Enrich message_sending hook with resolved target context

question: What resolved outbound target facts may ordinary loaded plugins receive on `message_sending`, and should that contract be nested as `targetContext` or exposed through another Plugin SDK shape?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the next step defines both a public Plugin SDK contract and a security disclosure boundary for channel/account/cross-context information.

options.title: Approve narrow target context
options.body: Expose only stable, policy-useful facts such as target kind, channel id, and cross-context/external booleans, populated from existing outbound resolver and policy state.

options.title: Keep hook raw for now
options.body: Leave `message_sending` unchanged until a broader plugin policy/trust model decides what target-resolution details plugins may observe.

options.title: Use explicit resolver helper
options.body: Document a supported plugin-side resolver path, accepting that plugins may need lookup cost and may not see the exact runtime-resolved destination for every send.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow target context
recommendation.body: Expose only stable, policy-useful facts such as target kind, channel id, and cross-context/external booleans, populated from existing outbound resolver and policy state.

likelyOwner.reason: This account is both the listed project maintainer and the strongest history owner for the outbound target-resolution and policy internals implicated by the decision.
